sources.title: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
sources.text: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.

sources.title: A new cookbook pays tribute to two New Orleans staples - 'Rhythm & Roux'
sources.text: At Bayou Bar, music and food go hand in hand. Which is why a new cookbook from chef Brian Landry and bandleader Peter Harris has recipes from the menu and stories from the musicians who play there.

sources.title: Iconic Carnegie Deli reopens in Midtown Manhattan after 10-year hiatus
sources.text: Carnegie Deli, famous for its sandwiches piled high with meat, has reopened as a sit-down restaurant in New York City after a 10-year hiatus.
